description: Estimate a password's entropy in bits from the character classes it actually draws from (lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols, other/Unicode), using the pool-size x length method. Returns a strength label and crack-time estimates at four guess-rate scenarios, plus warnings for repeated runs, sequential runs, short length, and single-character-class passwords. Measures resistance to brute force over the theoretical character space, not real-world guessability against a breach database.
name: estimate_password_entropy
